title: spec-judge-verdict contract data
description: Reference schema (FAFF-922). The SHAPE of the spec-review judge's ruling, emitted at the would-be-park point and overriding the refuter majority at the loop level. Shape is normative here; the WEIGHING (which objection is taste vs load-bearing) lives in the judge occupant, not the contract. Fail-loud on a verdict outside the enum (no safe coerce target — faff's own producer emits it). upheld/downweighted lens/severity are plain strings: their enum is enforced in the compute fn via violations (the spec-review-verdict precedent), so an echoed bad value never trips a spurious fail-loud.
